name: gm2
exec: (()=>{const S=window.__app.scene;const ray=new THREE.Raycaster();const c=window.__app.camera;const out=[];for(const [u,v] of [[0.35,0.55],[0.5,0.62],[0.28,0.45],[0.62,0.5]]){ray.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(u*2-1,v*2-1),c);const h=ray.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(i=>i.object.isMesh&&i.object.visible);if(h.length)out.push('uv('+u+','+v+') '+h.slice(0,2).map(i=>i.object.name).join(' > '));}return out.join(' | ')})()
